mcp_tools.name: zero_knowledge_system_design_pack
mcp_tools.title: Zero knowledge system design pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a zero-knowledge system design record (trust-model and key-custody declarations, client-encryption and sharing design declarations, proof-system and circuit design declarations, declared circuit rows, setup and verifier declarations, declared verifier rows, property and proof-selection declarations, recovery, limits and claim-mapping declarations with declared claim-mapping rows, red lines) and returns a deterministic ZK_DESIGN_RECORD_SOUND / ZK_DESIGN_RECORD_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed row completeness and uniqueness checks and exact recomputation of the declared constraint-count total over the declared circuit rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared design record only; it proves nothing, verifies no proof, runs no cryptography and certifies no security property.

inputSchema.description: The zero knowledge system design pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: All fields present, red lines false, total constraint count matches sum, lists non-empty. computed_spot_checks: zk_design_constraint_count_sum=100.000000, circuit_statement_coverage_ratio=1.000000
